decisions.decision: Thank-you note to the Friends of LPL, authored and read by Dick, to be sent to the Friends; it met with general approval from the trustees.

decisions.decision: Rules and regulations on youth behavior to be implemented; one approach discussed is a temporary ban on students who misbehave, with a three-strikes warning and sign-in sheet; update at the April meeting.
decisions.quote: rules and regulations to be implemented.

decisions.decision: Decision on how much of the Library Trust Funds to use for e-books to be made and recorded by the trustees at the September meeting.
decisions.quote: decision to be made and recorded by/for the trustees on how much - will be on the september meeting agenda.

decisions.decision: Personnel sub-committee (Harry, Kiirja, Gare and Dick) to combine the individual director evaluations into one by the comment sections.
decisions.quote: explanation on how the individual submitted evaluations will be combined into one (the comment sections) by the personnel sub-committee (harry, kiirja, gare and dick)

decisions.decision: Personnel sub-committee meeting for the Director Evaluation set for March 24th at the LPL.
decisions.quote: set personnel sub-committee meeting for director evaluation

decisions.decision: Board noted the guest comment that policy and procedures should be worded in conjunction with town counsel.
decisions.quote: troy daniels' comment - policy and procedures should be "worded" in conjunction with town counsel.

decisions.decision: Room use by for-profit entities (BPL Policies) scheduled for discussion in April; Access and Use of Library Trust Funds scheduled for September; Marketing/Technology subcommittee, BOS Energy Policy and Library of Things listed as future agenda items.
decisions.quote: room use by for-profit entities (bpl policies), to be discussed in april.
